$comment: Single source of truth for role file boundaries and turn budgets. Consumed by scripts/boundary-check.mjs (PreToolUse hook), the file_ownership / write_paths_in_boundary deterministic checks, and the /deliver orchestrator when spawning role subagents. Globs are relative to the target repo root. Layout is the Workers-first canonical shape (settled policy S-001). The top-level readonly list holds scaffold-manifest paths that no builder may edit; it is empty here and populated per-run once the scaffold materializes (D11).
